value.rationale: The alternating sign is a canonical irreducible group character whose expectation is an exactly computable spectral mode. Its odd/even separation shows a natural obstruction at precisely the full-chain q^{-2} scale only for odd decks and a faster q^{-1} decay for even decks, with explicit constants and two distinct nq crossover profiles; this is not just a routine normalization of the already known full-chain mixing bound.
